boundaries.statement: On full L2 the zero Fourier mode is stationary and equals the conserved spatial mean.
At alpha=kappa exactly the represented shell n=1 is neutral and has real dimension 2d.
Every fastest-shell tie is retained as a full spectral projection rather than broken numerically.
The kappa=0 face is forward heat for alpha<0, identity for alpha=0, and ill posed as a bounded L2 semigroup for alpha>0.
No cubic Cahn--Hilliard dynamics, nonlinear saturation, phase coarsening, or pattern-selection theorem is claimed.
The theorem holds for every finite integer d>=1; finite receipts only audit dimensions one through six.

collision_boundary.C195: C195 is nonlinear periodic viscous Burgers through Cole--Hopf; C304 is a linear fourth-order conserved gradient flow in every finite dimension.
collision_boundary.C206_C213_C217_C218_C261_C277: Earlier Fourier packages have different transport, hyperbolic, dispersive, fractional, or damping generators; C304 is the fourth-order spinodal shell and energy-signature atlas.

model.generator: A_{kappa,alpha}=-kappa Delta^2-alpha Delta with domain H^4 intersect L2_0
model.phase_space: mean-zero L2 on the 2pi-periodic d-torus for every finite integer d>=1

nonclaims: No target arithmetic local datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, divisor law, functional equation, or zero match is asserted.
Lattice wavevectors and shell multiplicities are source Fourier geometry, not rational-prime labels or target coefficients.
The self-adjoint source generator is not asserted to be a Hilbert--Polya operator.
No literature novelty or priority is claimed for the classical Cahn--Hilliard linearization or Fourier semigroup.

proof_contract.fastest_exhaustion: If alpha/kappa<=1 then shell n=1 is maximal; if alpha/kappa>1 then every n>=alpha/kappa has nonpositive rate while shell n=1 is positive, so only represented n below that bound can maximize.
proof_contract.finite_role: Finite dimensions and shells are regression receipts only and do not prove the arbitrary-d theorem.
proof_contract.full_dimension: Fourier diagonalization and lattice-shell multiplicities prove the theorem for every finite d>=1.
proof_contract.nonlinear_firewall: The linearized equation does not imply nonlinear saturation, coarsening, or pattern selection.

theorem_contract.atlas: strict stability, critical kernel, spinodal Morse index, fastest represented ties, and actual-support long-time projection
theorem_contract.energy: F=one-half integral(kappa|grad u|^2-alpha u^2) and Fdot=-norm(grad chemical_potential)^2
theorem_contract.recurrence: every recurrent state is stationary; there is no nonstationary periodic solution
theorem_contract.semigroup: self-adjoint analytic trace-class semigroup for every positive time
theorem_contract.singular_boundary: at kappa=0: forward heat for alpha<0, identity for alpha=0, no bounded L2 C0 semigroup for alpha>0
theorem_contract.spectrum: sigma_n=alpha n-kappa n^2 with multiplicity r_d(n) on every represented shell n=|k|^2>0
